_comment: Pinned upstream dependencies, and what has to be true before one of them moves. Read by `bun run cat check:upstream-pins` and by the `upstream-pin-watch` / `upstream-version-adoption` processes under processes/. NOTE WHAT IS NOT HERE: the pinned version. It lives in the file the build reads, and `pinnedIn` + `pattern` say how to read it from there — a registry with its own copy would be a second answer to "what are we running", free to disagree with the build. LOCATION: the harness's declared `upstream/` directory since 2026-10-06 (bean `ar1s`; it sat at the repository root before); every `pinnedIn` resolves against the harness root, where the files the build reads live.

pins.title: just-the-docs Jekyll theme
binds: site-chrome/assets/js/docs-ui.js — MOVES the theme's own search markup into the action launcher; binds `.search`, `#search-input`, `.search-label`. An upstream rename degrades a shipped feature without failing the build.
site-chrome/assets/css/docs-ui.css — overrides `.side-bar`, `.site-header`, `.main-header`; `sidebar-panels.e2e.ts` records that the theme hard-caps `.site-header` height.
test/a11y.e2e.ts — fixtures reproduce the theme's own search markup, including that the accessible name comes from `<label for=search-input>` rather than an aria-label.
test/action-tiles.e2e.ts — asserts the theme's search element as rendered into `.main-header`.
test/sidebar-panels.e2e.ts — asserts the theme's sidebar column and capped header.
site-chrome/_includes/head_custom.html — pulled into every page by the theme.

site-chrome/_includes/css/activation.scss.liquid, components/breadcrumbs.html and components/children_nav.html — OVERRIDE the theme's files of those names ("cache the nav"). The theme re-derives each page's place in the nav on every page — re-walking the whole nav HTML for the first two, regrouping every page by parent for the third, each page touched costing a to_liquid that re-evaluates every front-matter `defaults` scope under Jekyll 3 — which is O(pages²) for the site. Here site-chrome/_includes/nav_cache/*.html compute those answers ONCE per build (include_cached) with the theme's own loops, and each page looks its answer up. The parts outside the marked blocks, and the maps' loop bodies, are the theme's verbatim; a pin move re-copies them and diffs a full build's pages against the theme's own output, which must be byte-identical.

site-chrome/_includes/vendor/anchor_headings.html and site-chrome/_layouts/table_wrappers.html — OVERRIDE the theme's files of those names so its two markup passes (heading anchors on the content, table wrappers on the whole page) skip <script> and <style> bodies; the theme's string replaces broke every inline script that builds HTML (owner's report 2026-10-15, /en/cat-harness/schemas/bootstrap/). anchor_headings_core.html is the theme's include VERBATIM, renamed; table_wrappers.html restates the theme's two replaces, and has NO parent layout: the theme's `vendor/compress` never ran here, because `exclude: vendor` keeps Jekyll from reading `_layouts/vendor/`, so `layout: null` states it. A pin move re-copies the first and re-reads the second; schemas/site-chrome.test.ts renders both.

site-chrome/_config.yml — `search_enabled`, `heading_anchors`, `color_scheme: dark`, `mermaid` are theme options; so are `keep_files` and `footer_content`, which the site sets in docs/_config.yml (its identity, overlaid on the chrome by compose-docs).

pins.title: Bun runtime
binds: Every `.github/workflows/*.yml` of the composed checkout — 59 `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` sites across folio-assistant's workflows on 2026-10-30 (22 when the pin was added) carry `bun-version` literals, and `check:bun-pin` fails if any disagrees with `.bun-version`. That gate is what makes this ONE answer rather than many: without it the copies would be free to disagree, which is exactly what this registry's own note forbids.

cat-harness-tools/pipeline/qa-utils.ts — `saveQaScriptSidecar` stamps `engine_version` (`bun-${Bun.version}`). It was a substantive field until #1452, so an unpinned runtime rewrote every script sidecar whenever the engine differed and took `bun run cat gates`' tree-mutation detector to 'NOT clean' on every branch (bean `3ozg`). It no longer triggers a write on its own, so a bump does not rewrite the sidecars; it records the engine of a sidecar's last CONTENT change.

cat-harness/test/results/script-sidecars/*.script.json — 86 committed records whose `engine_version` is this pin's observable consequence. They held TWO values when the pin was added: 72 at bun-1.3.14 and 14 at bun-1.3.11.

cat-harness/site-chrome/assets/js/navbar.js — minified by `Bun.build`, whose identifier choices change between releases; `navbar:assets:check` fails until it is regenerated (`bun run cat navbar:assets`) under the new pin.

Each layer's own workflows and workflow templates, which `check:bun-pin` does NOT read and so must be moved by hand: cat-harness, cat-harness-tools and folio-assistant-core `release-npm.yml`, cat-harness-tools' layer workflows, folio-assistant-core `templates/public-comment/github/workflows/*`, fhir-harness `ig-ast-refresh.yml` and `templates/ig-repo-site/site-publish.yml`, who-iris `checks.yml`.
folio-assistant test/workflows/merge-main-workflow.test.ts — asserts the `bun-version` literal of merge-main's `setup-bun` step.

pins.title: PlantUML diagram renderer (tool-release)
binds: cat-harness/tool-releases/plantuml-1.2026.9.json — `digest.digest` and `source.url` must be updated to the new release's jar and sha256, and the file renamed to match the version.
cat-harness/tool-releases/default.profile.json — `tools.plantuml` selects `plantuml@<version>`.
cat-harness-tools/scripts/plantuml-render.ts — `PLANTUML` re-exports the release pin and resolves it through `tool-releases.ts`.

Copies outside this registry that do not read it, and so must move by hand: `PLANTUML_VERSION` in https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/blob/main/scripts/ig-repo-site.ts, and the jar URL in folio-assistant `.github/workflows/docs-site.yml` and `feature-staging.yml`.

pins.title: Graphviz dot layout engine (tool-release)
binds: cat-harness/tool-releases/graphviz-16.1.1-linux-x64-ubuntu-24.04.json — `digest.digest` and `source.url` must be updated to the new `.deb` and sha256.
cat-harness/tool-releases/plantuml-1.2026.9.json — `runtimes[]` injects `graphviz@<version>` onto `PATH` so `plantuml` finds `dot`.
cat-harness/tool-releases/default.profile.json — `tools.graphviz` selects `graphviz@<version>`.
cat-harness/tool-releases/ci-2026-10.profile.json and cat-harness/tool-releases/lean-4.35-test.profile.json — `tools.graphviz` selects `graphviz@<version>`.

pins.title: FHIR Shorthand SUSHI compiler (tool-release)
binds: cat-harness/tool-releases/fsh-sushi-3.21.0.json — `digest.digest` and `source.url` must be updated to the new npm tarball and sha256, the file renamed to match the version, and `licence` re-read from the tarball (it is Apache-2.0).
cat-harness/tool-releases/ci-2026-10.profile.json — `tools["fsh-sushi"]` selects `fsh-sushi@<version>`.

pins.title: Node.js 22 LTS runtime (tool-release)
binds: cat-harness/tool-releases/node-22.23.4-linux-x64.json — `digest.digest`, `source.url` and `entry.home` must be updated to the new Node 22 LTS tarball and sha256.
cat-harness/tool-releases/fsh-sushi-3.21.0.json — `runtimes[]` injects `node@<version>` onto `PATH`.

pins.title: Lean 4 toolchain (tool-release)
binds: cat-harness/tool-releases/lean-toolchain-4.35.0.json — `digest.digest` and `source.url` must be updated to the new `lean-toolchain` file and sha256, and the file renamed to match the version. The source is a file whose content is `leanprover/lean4:v<version>` (Mathlib's `lean-toolchain` at its `v<version>` tag), NEVER leanprover/lean4's own `lean-toolchain`, which names the in-tree build rather than a release.
cat-harness/tool-releases/ci-2026-10.profile.json and lean-4.35-test.profile.json — `tools["lean-toolchain"]` selects `lean-toolchain@<version>`.
